meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先向你收集产品名称、价格、核心卖点、目标用户等信息,再按品类挑模板,产出带 emoji 的标题和四段式正文(痛点、产品、卖点、情感收尾),按 Markdown 输出;也能改写你已有的文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或文案优化需求时触发;Claude 会先收集产品信息,再按智能家居、数码配件等品类选择模板。

say.text: 给智能睡眠眼罩写一条电商文案,核心卖点是科学遮光
say.note: Claude 会先确认卖点和目标用户再出稿

say.text: 帮我优化这条充电宝文案的标题和正文,补上合适的 emoji
say.note: 它按标题、痛点、卖点、emoji 逐项改

say.text: 给环保可降解餐具写标题和四段式正文

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude asks for your product's info, picks a template by category, then writes an emoji title and a four-part body (pain point, product, benefits, emotional close) in Markdown. It also rewrites existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ecommerce copywriting or copy optimization. Claude gathers product details first, then picks a template by category such as smart home or digital accessories.

say_en.text: Write ecommerce copy for a smart sleep eye mask; key point: light blocking
say_en.note: Claude confirms selling points and audience first

say_en.text: Improve the title and body of this power bank copy and add emoji
say_en.note: It revises title, pain point, benefits and emoji

say_en.text: Write a title and four-part body for eco-friendly tableware
